name: Juniper Quinn
presence: Juniper Quinn sells futures from a counter of black glass. Her smile reaches everything but her eyes.
greeting: "If it has a price, it is already on the slate. If it doesn't, you can't afford the conversation."

wafer.say: "Black wafer. Eighteen. It is half a key and a whole alibi. The other half is white and sulking in a well, if the rumors still pay rent."

gloves.say: "Insulated. Fourteen. The rooftop cable is not a metaphor. There is also a pair under a drone, if you prefer violence to retail."

spire.say: "I sell the piece. I do not sell the ending. Endings ruin repeat business."

ash.say: "ASH is a customer who never paid her last invoice. If you are working for her, charge double. She can afford a city."

combat.onDeathSay: Juniper falls across her own slate. The bazaar inhales and decides it saw nothing. Her stock is suddenly a public resource.
